result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, signals, and sidewalks. However, the wide multi-lane configuration and lack of a median refuge island increase exposure risk for pedestrians crossing the main thoroughfare.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection.

hazards.name: Roadway Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracks in the asphalt surface within the intersection area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a well-maintained sidewalk with a curb ramp. However, there are no visible pedestrian signal heads at this signalized crossing, and the wide roadway geometry may facilitate higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signal heads
hazards.description: While a push button is likely present on the pole, no pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners on the right side of the frame

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The wide turn from the side street onto the main road can encourage higher vehicle speeds during turns, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right corner of the intersection where the sidewalk meets the road

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add countdown pedestrian signals to all legs of the intersection to provide clear crossing instructions and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the turn radius.

result.summary: The environment features a residential setting with a sidewalk and a marked crosswalk equipped with a tactile curb ramp. However, the crossing is uncontrolled across a wide roadway with no pedestrian signals or warning signs, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: A marked crosswalk exists without any traffic control signals or pedestrian warning signs to alert drivers.

hazards.name: Roadway Maintenance/Obstruction
hazards.description: Traffic cones and uneven pavement near the curb ramp may create minor trip hazards or confusion for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk near the curb ramp

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs (W11-2) to alert motorists of the crossing location.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features signalized crossings with high-visibility continental markings and pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway with multiple travel lanes creates a significant crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a prolonged period.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection of Bustleton Ave

hazards.name: Multiple Travel Lanes
hazards.description: Multiple lanes of traffic in each direction increase the risk of multiple-threat crashes where one vehicle stops but another does not.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.
